reviews.title: Best in this price, Slight adjustment, Amazing quality.
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1pvcf1C-3L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/613O7lNO4jL._SY256.jpg It’s an OLED so its gonna be good. I didn’t have any text fringing or eye strain even after 4 hours straight use. Picture quality is great. Brightness is good enough for me.Im impressed by the colors on it. It doesn’t get any better in this price.
Now the cons are that the upper side of the panel is very thin so if I want to tilt it up or down with my monitor arm I’d feel more confident doing it holding the bottom part.
The HDMI doesn’t support more than 165hz on this monitor so I had to use display port for that sweet 240hz refresh rate. You could use an HDMI to DP cable if you don’t have any display port option in your pc or laptop.
The bezels are a bit thicker than I expected, You’ll notice it if you work or play in bright room. For me it’s no problem. My roommate has an Samsung g5 OLED and it feels smaller than that for some reason even though it’s same size. (Image quality is better than Samsung in this).
It’s a glossy display, part of the reason why content looks better than Samsung g5. But in a bright room or average light room if you are watching something dark-ish you will see all the reflection on it. While gaming it’s not noticeable.
Overall a little bit adjustment but very good for the price.
reviews.author: Bobby Chowdhury

reviews.title: Amazing monitor!
reviews.comment: Amazing monitor for the price. Very fast, and the OLED looks amazing. Build quality is good, and was absolutely no problem setting it up on my VESA mount. The screen is also bright enough for my room, couldn't speak to using it outside but in a normal desk setting it's adequate.
reviews.author: Eli Oceanak

reviews.title: Best budget OLED hands down
reviews.comment: For the price this is an excellent monitor. At first glance the monitor may look a little dim, but if you mess around with the settings you’ll see the burn in protection settings are turned on by default. Specifically “Uniform Brightness” which dims the entire monitor. Pretty sweet for web browsing and coding and stuff, where some elements might be in the same spot for a while. Turning it off however, makes the screen look fantastic. Super deep darkness with vibrant colors, especially if you take the time to find the right hdr settings. All in all for 360 dollars this is a stellar buy.
reviews.author: bluto

reviews.title: Pretty good for the price
reviews.comment: This monitor is pretty good for the price. There are some trade-off like the lack of HDMI 2.1 and some other ports, but if you don't care too much about that like me then that's all good. The HDR is meh at best, but that's a trade off at this price and if HDR isn't your biggest priority you should be fine. I use it in a light controlled room and I don't even notice the magenta tint on the monitor unless light directly beams straight into it. The bright is not too bad either even if its on the lower end of thing. Cleaning it isn't an issue as I thought it would be due to it being QD-OLED, but with enough care there shouldn't be an issue. While not an issue for me, the stand is pretty bad since it's short and lacks much control. Just pop this thing onto a monitor arm and it's fine. Overall decent for the price, great starter monitor for the OLED scene.
reviews.author: Brian

reviews.title: in love with this monitor
reviews.comment: this was a MASSIVE upgrade from my last monitor in EVERY department (onn 24 inch IPS 100hz). this is also my first OLED. i'm blown away. amazing picture quality, great colors. i was really worried about HDR after all of the reviews saying it's really bad on this monitor. i calibrated it, changed the setting in the AOC g-menu software to "displayHDR" and tweaked the colors slightly in the AMD software and i think it looks fantastic in my games. this is also my first HDR monitor though, so i have no real reference point lol... i will say if you turn HDR off though this monitor is not very bright at all. as others have said, brightness is linked to contrast on this monitor, so if you need to increase it, you can use that as a workaround.
